description: Covers the release lifecycle of research software: preparing and cutting versioned releases with changelogs, versioning schemes, release automation and minting a DOI per release. Use when the user asks how to tag a v1.0.0 release, write release notes or a changelog, pick a versioning scheme (SemVer or CalVer), automate releases, or mint a release DOI. (Channel craft for PyPI/CRAN/conda and registries is rseng-software-publishing; long-term preservation is rseng-archiving.)
